annotations.text:
OPTION A — Findability fixes
Keeps today's five tabs (Home · Cellar · + · Explore · Profile).

What changes: Home tiles become labeled links, Profile gets a 'Your journal' section, a new Your places list screen, and the + sheet gains a Browse row.

Why: 1–2 days, no structural risk, nothing testers already know moves.
Tradeoff: tastings still have no tab of their own; the main route stays 'Home tile' or 'Profile row'.

OPTION B — Journal tab (recommended)
Home · Journal · + · Explore · Profile.

Journal is one screen with Tastings / Places / Wishlist segments, grouped by visit. Cellar leaves the bar and lives in a Home card, a Profile row, and the + sheet.

Why: the thing people create most gets a tab; 'where are my wines' becomes one obvious tap.
Tradeoff: cellar users lose a dedicated tab (still one tap from Home); +2–3 days.

APPLIES TO BOTH
Pin sheet: 'View winery & your notes' is the primary row; 'Log a visit here' goes straight into the log flow. A persistent ? on the map brings the drop-pin hint back.

Winery page: Your visits sits above About, the latest visit is expanded, and the canned About sentence is gone.

All names, wines and counts here are sample data.
